body:
Good morning all

Just a heads up that tomorrow evening we are hosting a bbq for around 20-25
people. Same drill as every year 😎

We will of course try to keep the noise down and as Morgan Jones did a super job of
cleaning the bbq yesterday smoke shouldn’t be a problem.

Enjoy the weekend ahead.

Wendy and Henning
